metadata.description: A software development lifecycle for AI coding agents, with gates that hold.

plugins.name: eng-brain
plugins.description: Brain-grounded SDLC pipeline: story -> arch -> contract -> slice -> fleet -> before-pr -> pr -> canary. Stage order and gates are enforced in code rather than prose, so a stage cannot be marked complete out of order and a test suite cannot be declared green without runner output. Architectural decisions are written back to gbrain so the next feature inherits them.
